name: 90north-develop
description: North's development plugin: two loops split by type of work, the same 9 steps in each, on one discipline. n-defect-loop: defects — read the board, triage, check the spec, reproduce with a red e2e and a before video, root cause at path:line, test-first fix (defect-repro, defect-fixer), verify and record, open the PR into the QA lane. n-develop-loop: new development, features and changed requirements — the same steps with acceptance specs red, the n-dev design note and work packages (a gate for Large or schema/interface changes) and a test-first build (dev-builder), PR into the review lane. Step 9: only a low- or no-impact change inside a standing approval merges on its own; everything else waits for a person. Every change gets a code review, a security and a performance review (risk-reviewer) and QA. Both run attended (every question asked once, in one decision round before anything is built, then to the end), or unattended with --auto: queue and lock, triage matrix, adversarial verifier (loop-verifier), ship classes, learning (loop-learner). workflow: the router, the shared stages, the auto mode and the tracker door (tracker.sh: Jira, or a local board of markdown cards when there is no Jira). n-dev: how every change is written (design first, modular, reuse, extension files, one owner per fact, test-first, verified), with a structure check for layers, weakened tests and new dependencies. n-arch: each repo's architecture profile plus the .ndev.toml rules the check enforces. Project facts live in each repo's .claude/90north-develop/, written by /90north-develop:develop-init. Both keep a feature doc per area true in every PR (rules with sources, rule → test, decisions).
